title: Support multiple bank transfer accounts and preconfigure provided bank details

requirements.text: Update the backend bank transfer storage to support multiple bank accounts (not a single BankDetails record), while keeping admin-only write access and authenticated-user read access.

quotes:
ACCNT NAME:  USMAN UMAR
 BANK NAME:   OPAY
 ACCNT NO:       9033449260 ...
 BANK NAME:   MONIE POINT
 ACCNT NO:       9033449260 ...
 BANK NAME:   POLARIS BANK
 ACCNT NO:       3028545600

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes a query method that returns a list/array of bank accounts to authenticated users.
Backend exposes an admin-only method to save/update the full list of bank accounts.
Existing authorization behavior is preserved: only admins can modify; only authenticated users can view.
No additional backend actors/services are introduced (single-actor architecture preserved).

requirements.text: Implement a conditional state migration so that if existing deployments have a single saved bankDetails record, it is migrated into the new multi-account list on upgrade without data loss.
acceptanceCriteria: On upgrade, if old single bankDetails exists, it becomes a single entry in the new bank accounts list.
After upgrade, bank transfer retrieval continues to work and returns the migrated account(s).
Migration logic is conditional and does not overwrite an already-populated multi-account list.

requirements.text: Preconfigure the app with the user-provided bank accounts so customers can immediately use bank transfer after deployment/upgrade (unless the admin has already configured a different set of accounts). Accounts to include: (1) Bank Name: OPAY, Account Name: USMAN UMAR, Account Number: 9033449260; (2) Bank Name: MONIE POINT, Account Name: USMAN UMAR, Account Number: 9033449260; (3) Bank Name: POLARIS BANK, Account Name: USMAN UMAR, Account Number: 3028545600.

quotes:

acceptanceCriteria: If no bank accounts are configured yet, the backend returns exactly the three specified accounts.
If the admin has already saved bank accounts, the backend does not overwrite them with defaults.

requirements.text: Update the frontend React Query hooks and types so the app reads and saves a list of bank transfer accounts (instead of a single bankDetails object), following the existing patterns in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts.
acceptanceCriteria: The bank transfer query hook returns an array/list of bank accounts (or null/empty state if unavailable).
The bank transfer save mutation accepts an array/list of bank accounts and invalidates the appropriate query keys on success.
No changes are made to immutable frontend paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.frontend.immutablePaths.

requirements.text: Update the admin bank transfer setup UI to manage multiple bank accounts: allow adding, editing, and removing bank accounts; validate required fields (bank name, account name, account number) for each entry; and save the full list to the backend. All user-facing text must be in English.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin UI shows the current list of configured bank accounts (preconfigured defaults should appear if admin has not changed them).
Admin can add a new bank account entry and remove an existing entry before saving.
Validation prevents saving if any bank account entry is missing bank name, account name, or account number, with English error messages.
Saving updates backend state and the UI shows a clear English success confirmation.

requirements.text: Update the customer-facing bank transfer details dialog to support selecting which bank account to pay into when multiple accounts exist, and ensure all copy actions and displayed details use the selected account. All user-facing text must be in English.
acceptanceCriteria: When multiple accounts are available, the dialog provides an obvious selection control (e.g., tabs or radio group) to choose OPAY vs MONIE POINT vs POLARIS BANK (and any future accounts).
The displayed Bank Name / Account Name / Account Number fields reflect the currently selected account.
“Copy All Details” copies the currently selected account’s details (plus IBAN/BIC if present).
If only one account exists, the dialog behaves like before (no required selection step).

requirements.text: Ensure the WhatsApp bank-transfer confirmation CTA continues to work with the multi-account flow, and include the selected bank name in the prefilled confirmation message (while keeping the WhatsApp number unchanged: 09033449260).
acceptanceCriteria: The WhatsApp confirmation link still opens WhatsApp to 09033449260.
The prefilled message includes the plan summary (as currently implemented) and additionally includes the selected bank name (e.g., “Paid into: OPAY”).
The CTA remains available and functional for every network-specific plan and any selected bank account.

constraints: Use English for any user-facing text.
Respect single-actor backend architecture (all Motoko logic in backend/main.mo).
Do not edit any frontend files under SYSTEM_CONTEXT.frontend.immutablePaths.
Keep the existing global WhatsApp number unchanged: 09033449260.
Follow the existing React Query patterns in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts for fetching/saving configuration.
nonGoals: Do not change Stripe checkout behavior or Stripe configuration UX beyond what is necessary to keep the app compiling.
Do not add third-party authentication providers (Internet Identity only).
Do not introduce external databases or additional backend services.
Do not redesign the landing page sections unrelated to bank transfer configuration/selection.
